title: History of Dairy Farming (1500 - 1900)
text:
1500
> Cheddar and parmesan cheese was created.

1700-1800
> Gouda and camembert cheese was created.

1900
> Modern dairy farming began.
> Louis Pasture originated the process of pasteurization.

Dairysquare - Dairy Farming Module

facts: Around 1500, cheddar and parmesan cheese were created.
During the period 1700-1800, gouda and camembert cheese were created.
Louis Pasture (Pasteur) originated the process of pasteurization (associated with the 1900 timeline entry).
This document page is part of the Dairysquare Dairy Farming Module, Page 5.

questions.question: According to the historical timeline, which cheeses were created around the year 1500?
Between 1700 and 1800, which two types of cheese were created?
What significant development in the dairy industry began around 1900 according to the module?

options.C: Invention of commercial cheese rind wax

questions.question: Who is credited on this timeline with originating the process of pasteurization?
Is the following statement true or false? 'Gouda and Camembert cheese were created around the year 1500.'

options.A: True, both originated in 1500 alongside Cheddar.
options.B: False, Cheddar and Parmesan were created around 1500, while Gouda and Camembert were created in 1700-1800.
options.C: False, they were created in 1900 when modern dairy farming began.
options.D: True, all major cheeses shown were created in the 1500s.
